label: Updated at 8 a.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Irish Open lead change
items.text: Joaquin Niemann surged with four straight birdies to shoot 5-under 65 and lead by two shots, while Rory McIlroy sits four back after a windy 1-under 69 opening round.

items.headline: Trump to attend Ryder Cup
items.text: Donald Trump confirmed plans to attend the 2027 Ryder Cup at Adare Manor, Ireland, despite expected protests that could intensify security concerns.

items.headline: Tiger Woods on PGA board
items.text: Tiger Woods joined a crucial meeting to finalize the 2028 PGA Tour promotion and relegation structure amid major eligibility rule reconsiderations.
